pressures.observed: SortKey participates in presentation/order and import matching
pressures.risk: ordering or import changes can be mistaken for semantic identity changes
pressures.teiDirection: separate legacy external key/provenance from canonical identity

pressures.observed: basic-design Function set and executable Function set are not one-to-one
pressures.risk: helper/runtime functions can be promoted to business meaning or design-only functions can disappear
pressures.teiDirection: separate Function/Interaction meaning from Realization

pressures.observed: legacy tooling contains relationship field matching paths based on shape/data type
pressures.risk: same-typed fields can produce ambiguous or incorrect mapping
pressures.teiDirection: require explicit field mapping or keep unresolved

pressures.observed: declared Function/Table CRUD coexists with Script APIs capable of SQL/Table operations
pressures.risk: actual effects can exceed declared CRUD
pressures.teiDirection: cross-check declared effect with native effect; do not silently claim completeness

pressures.observed: commit/rollback behavior can depend on caller context, return code, or session lifecycle
pressures.risk: target/agent changes can change transaction semantics
pressures.teiDirection: make command transaction/effect boundary explicit

pressures.observed: runtime specification contains database endpoint/user/password/path settings
pressures.risk: business meaning can become coupled to credentials and environment authority
pressures.teiDirection: separate canonical meaning, environment binding, secret, and runtime authority

pressures.observed: login/shared scripts and session attributes can affect function behavior
pressures.risk: individual function source is insufficient for replay
pressures.teiDirection: record explicit dependency/provenance or preserve as native code with required capabilities

pressures.observed: business Role/Task and runtime user/menu controls are separate concerns
pressures.risk: business actor can be mistaken for principal or authorization role
pressures.teiDirection: keep actor, principal, policy, and resource authority separate

pressures.observed: business-flow stores include ledger/store/folder/subject concepts beyond database tables
pressures.risk: physical/document/human state can be collapsed into Data
pressures.teiDirection: preserve external/physical/human boundary or keep unresolved

pressures.observed: Instance/SortKey can represent temporal change or presentation sequence depending on context
pressures.risk: presentation order can be translated as lifecycle semantics
pressures.teiDirection: separate Dataset, Snapshot, Scenario, Expectation, Presentation Order

pressures.observed: legacy external table reference/sync relies on file path and identifier conventions
pressures.risk: copy/sync can become a second source of truth and relation authority can drift
pressures.teiDirection: reuse semantic identity/version/provenance rather than copied authority

pressures.observed: field/function descriptions can carry validation, derived logic, or technical notes
pressures.risk: AI extraction can be mistaken for accepted specification
pressures.teiDirection: treat extraction as proposal/unresolved until accepted

pressures.observed: XF function classes combine interaction shape and concrete Driver implementation
pressures.risk: legacy Java/UI taxonomy can leak into core semantics
pressures.teiDirection: separate reusable pattern/interaction meaning from target realization

pressures.observed: parameter/return/session maps use dynamic keys
pressures.risk: call contract remains in caller convention and cannot be safely reused
pressures.teiDirection: promote stable meaning to typed input/result contracts; preserve dynamic remainder as native

pressures.observed: panel/report layout metadata lives close to function definition
pressures.risk: visual changes can be mistaken for semantic changes
pressures.teiDirection: keep semantic, functional, and visual evidence separate

pressures.observed: single-driver operation does not require all retry/unknown/idempotency semantics to be explicit
pressures.risk: network/agent/distributed execution can duplicate effects or report false success
pressures.teiDirection: route execution through RQ-018 to RQ-020 command/observation/retry/unknown boundaries

pressures.observed: TaskFunctionIO.Operations includes target-specific instructions such as pressing an update button or selecting a row and pressing Enter
pressures.risk: business action meaning can be coupled to one GUI interaction and change when the target changes
pressures.teiDirection: separate business action, referenced Function/Capability, and target-specific interaction instruction

pressures.observed: the reference combines heterogeneous Data, Function, Business, UI, lifecycle, Script, and runtime constructs under one legacy model/runtime family
pressures.risk: a compatibility importer can become a second canonical model or force legacy kinds into TEI Core
pressures.teiDirection: treat imported meaning as candidate Semantic Extensions/Plugins and native assets; keep importer authority separate and preserve unresolved mappings

pressures.observed: TaskFunctionIO selects a Panel or Spool, while the legacy task/table CRUD matrix aggregates every IOTable declared by the referenced Function
pressures.risk: Function-wide potential data access can be mistaken for the data effect of one Business Action or one interaction path
pressures.teiDirection: keep Function-level operation authority separate from Business Action attribution; require an explicit path-specific link before deriving action-specific CRUD

pressures.observed: 35 of 148 TaskAction elements in the benchmark have no ID and are primarily located by parent context, SortKey, indentation, and source position
pressures.risk: source-local ordering can be promoted to durable semantic identity or cross-view references can become unstable
pressures.teiDirection: separate exact-snapshot source locator from durable Business step addressability; add durable identity only when Reference pressure requires it

pressures.observed: Task.Event expresses business timing such as on-demand work, while executable functions can independently carry TimerOption runtime scheduling
pressures.risk: business event wording can be compiled into scheduler semantics or runtime schedule can be mistaken for business trigger meaning
pressures.teiDirection: separate Business trigger/event, scheduling policy, and executable capability binding

pressures.observed: the same native Script mechanism can validate data, derive values, update related tables, and change presentation properties such as editable state or color
pressures.risk: native Script extraction can collapse deterministic business semantics, persistence effects, and target-specific presentation effects into one canonical rule
pressures.teiDirection: preserve native Script first; extract semantic validation/derivation and presentation contribution separately only with explicit evidence and acceptance

pressures.observed: the executable System definition names special tables for users, sessions, numbering, calendar, tax, exchange rates, variants, and other platform services
pressures.risk: one reference application's physical table identities can become hard-coded platform semantics
pressures.teiDirection: represent reusable service meaning through Extension/Capability contracts and environment/database bindings rather than Core-known table names

pressures.observed: 21 of 80 Relationship elements carry non-empty ExistWhen1 prose such as conditional existence statements
pressures.risk: conditional relationship meaning can be dropped, or natural-language text can be over-promoted to an executable constraint
pressures.teiDirection: preserve conditional existence as source-backed proposal/unresolved and promote it to Validation/Lifecycle semantics only through explicit acceptance

pressures.observed: 52 Xead TableFields are DERIVABLE; 51 structurally match Xeaf VIRTUAL fields, while the actual calculation can live in Script, TypeOptions, or other runtime logic
pressures.risk: DERIVABLE/VIRTUAL labels can be mistaken for complete derivation semantics or runtime Script can become the only hidden source of business meaning
pressures.teiDirection: separate derived-value semantic contract from native evaluator/realization; preserve missing derivation authority as unresolved

pressures.observed: XeadModeler represents ordered multi-field TableKey/TableKeyField sets, distinguishes PK/FK/SK/XK, emits PK as PRIMARY KEY and SK as UNIQUE, and Relationship links both participating TableKey identities
pressures.risk: legacy database key declarations or relationship key references can be promoted directly to TEI business occurrence identity, candidate key, or functional dependency without preserving the difference between source assertion and accepted business meaning
pressures.teiDirection: preserve legacy key kind, ordered field membership, relationship key references, and provenance as source facts; keep business identifier, candidate key, and functional dependency candidate/unresolved until explicitly accepted or independently corroborated

pressures.observed: XeadDriver record/detail functions may declare Function/Detail KeyFields; only when that override is absent do XF290/XF390 fall back to the target Table PK
pressures.risk: a Function or UI record-selection key can be mistaken for Table identity or durable business identity, coupling interaction realization back into Data meaning
pressures.teiDirection: model record-selection/input keys as Function/Interaction requirements distinct from table key assertions, business occurrence identity, Canonical identity, and physical primary key

pressures.observed: Watanabe distinguishes functional dependency from domain restriction: a composite value set can require an explicit allowed relation even when no dependent attribute exists
pressures.risk: treating every composite key only as record identity or dependency evidence can lose the business meaning of allowed combinations and can over-normalize or under-constrain transferred Data
pressures.teiDirection: keep composite domain/allowed-combination constraints distinct from business identity and functional dependency; preserve source evidence and leave semantic promotion unresolved until an explicit Constraint/Relation contract is accepted

pressures.observed: Watanabe models derived attributes as logical fields and allows a derived value to participate in a foreign-key-like dynamic reference; the benchmark has 52 DERIVABLE Xead fields, but participation of those fields in Relationship keys has not yet been confirmed
pressures.risk: derived values may be reduced to display/cache fields, or native Script may become the only hidden authority for a Relation whose source key is actually derived
pressures.teiDirection: separate derived-value semantic contract, evaluator realization, materialized cache, and Relation use; keep benchmark dynamic-reference occurrence unresolved until exact source mapping confirms it

pressures.observed: Watanabe warns that an AI-ready semantic/ontology layer reconstructed from database definitions, application source and documents cannot reliably recover business meaning when the underlying structured model no longer expresses the relevant functional dependencies; RMT itself reconstructs candidates from legacy XML, code and prose
pressures.risk: a coherent AI-generated semantic graph can be mistaken for original or accepted system meaning, turning the importer or knowledge layer into a second canonical authority
pressures.teiDirection: keep source-faithful observation, AI-derived candidate and accepted semantic meaning as separate authority stages; require provenance and Shared Acceptance before reconstructed meaning enters authoritative Source

pressures.observed: Watanabe's 2026-09 critique distinguishes retaining legacy business identifiers as ordinary identifier attributes from actually preserving the uniqueness and functional-dependency structure that made them business identifiers
pressures.risk: migration or interoperability can appear identity-preserving because identifier values survive while uniqueness scope, temporal validity, relation semantics, and impact analysis are lost
pressures.teiDirection: treat identifier-like fields as source facts only; promote them to accepted business occurrence identity or candidate key only with explicit uniqueness scope, source/contract responsibility, temporal conditions, and relation/constraint evidence

pressures.observed: Watanabe's 2026-07 argument separates service-oriented data linkage from the harder task of designing one logically coherent data structure across organizational systems
pressures.risk: API/message connectivity can be reported as integration while business identity, relation, constraint, and ownership remain fragmented across systems
pressures.teiDirection: allow N:M Database/Service topology while preserving cross-system logical identity, relation, constraint, ownership, and provenance; do not require a single physical database and do not treat connectivity alone as semantic integration

pressures.observed: XeadModeler orders TableKeyField members by SortKey when handling relationships and uses TableField DataTypeID while finding corresponding fields; XML source order and AttributeType are therefore insufficient for checking composite key correspondence
pressures.risk: a transfer tool can pair the wrong composite-key members while reporting the relationship as structurally valid, especially when XML order differs or SortKey is missing/duplicated
pressures.teiDirection: preserve SourceOrdinal, SortKey, AttributeType, and DataTypeID separately; compare composite relationship members by unambiguous SortKey order and report ambiguous order or explicit data-type mismatch as unresolved rather than repairing by name/type heuristics

pressures.observed: Watanabe's 2026-09 proposal for name variants separates a person's socially significant original representation from the simplified character representation used operationally by administrative systems
pressures.risk: normalization, variant replacement, case folding, or code conversion can be mistaken for proof that two source values identify the same business occurrence, or representation differences can be mistaken for distinct identity
pressures.teiDirection: preserve exact source representation when required, keep normalized/search/rendering representations separate, and require an explicit scoped equivalence policy or mapping before representation equality contributes to business identity evidence

pressures.observed: Watanabe argues that detailed current-state analysis can bias redesign toward preserving the current system; RMT intentionally increases the fidelity of legacy observation
pressures.risk: a high-quality source-faithful transcription can be mistaken for the desired TEI design, preserving accidental legacy topology and runtime constraints precisely because they are now well understood
pressures.teiDirection: keep source observation, target Proposal and Accepted To-Be as separate authority stages; retain compatibility and migration evidence without copying As-Is structure into Desired by default

pressures.observed: Watanabe distinguishes discovering a functional-dependency network from mechanically transforming an established dependency structure into tables
pressures.risk: AI can be used twice as an implicit authority: first to invent semantic dependencies and then to re-interpret already accepted meaning while generating physical schemas
pressures.teiDirection: use AI/human reasoning for evidence-backed proposals, require normal Acceptance for semantic meaning, then use deterministic versioned validators/planners/compilers for transformations that are fully defined by accepted Data/Relation/Constraint semantics

pressures.observed: legacy Xead XML can be malformed, partially merged, or hand-edited so that Table, Field, TableKey, or Relationship identifiers are missing or duplicated; lookup-based importers can otherwise overwrite one occurrence with another or notice missing identity only when a downstream reference happens to touch it
pressures.risk: source order, traversal order, or absence of a referencing path can determine whether invalid source identity is noticed, and downstream key/relation resolution can bind to an arbitrary duplicate occurrence
pressures.teiDirection: diagnose missing and duplicate source identities directly from source facts; do not collapse duplicate Table/Field/Key/Relationship IDs into one semantic result, do not borrow metadata from an arbitrary occurrence, and keep dependent meaning unresolved

pressures.observed: source-faithful inspection intentionally preserves relational facts even when diagnostics show missing, duplicate, mismatched, or otherwise unresolved relational structure
pressures.risk: a downstream importer can treat the mere presence or count of extracted facts as proof that those facts are safe inputs to deterministic semantic lowering
pressures.teiDirection: publish relational resolution status separately from observed facts; keep unresolved facts as Evidence, but block deterministic semantic lowering until relational diagnostics are cleared or explicitly accepted through a later authority boundary
